item.title: Secure Secrets Management Architecture
item.description: Integrated Azure Key Vault with Kubernetes (AKS) for Zero Trust security.

item.title: Advanced Cloud & GitOps Implementations
item.description: This portfolio showcases recent hands-on projects, including a GitOps deployment pipeline on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with ArgoCD, a fully Terraform-codified AWS serverless CI/CD architecture, and an EKS-based three-tier e-commerce platform integrating Jenkins and ArgoCD.

item.title: Secure CI/CD: Decoupling IaC from Application Builds
item.description: This article details a critical best practice for CI/CD pipelines: strictly decoupling Infrastructure as Code (IaC) from application builds. It explains how this approach enhances security by enforcing least privilege and improves efficiency, outlining a secure architecture using separate pipelines for infrastructure provisioning and application delivery with GitOps.

item.title: Voting Application CD with GitOps and ArgoCD
item.description: Implemented a continuous deployment pipeline for a Voting Application, leveraging GitOps and ArgoCD to deploy Docker images from Azure Container Registry to an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster.
